# CustomDamageNumbers

> Packet-based floating damage numbers for Minecraft. Nothing is spawned into the world: every number is a client-side display entity sent over the protocol, anchored to the entity that took the hit. Config-driven animation, hit merging, style profiles, a per-player toggle. Two jars from one codebase: 1.20.2 - 26.x (modern) and 1.17.x - 1.20.1 (legacy). Apache-2.0 with the Commons Clause.

## Install

Drop the jar that matches your server version into `plugins/` next to PacketEvents 2.14:

- `CustomDamageNumbers-1.0.0.jar` - Minecraft 1.20.2 to 26.x, TextDisplay renderer with fade and scale
- `CustomDamageNumbers-Legacy-1.0.0.jar` - Minecraft 1.17.x to 1.20.1, armour stand renderer, position-only animation

Java 17 or newer. One hard dependency: PacketEvents. LuckPerms and PlaceholderAPI are optional.

## Core capabilities

- Packet-only rendering: no entities are spawned, so uninstalling leaves nothing behind
- Entity-anchored animation: the number follows the damaged entity (follow-entity, anchor-height, follow-smoothing)
- Config-driven animation: duration, rise, fall, bounce, orbit, scale, fade, spawn spread
- Hit merging: rapid hits on the same victim grow one number (merge-system.merge-window-ms)
- Styles and style profiles: normal, critical, fire, poison, magic, explosion, healing, fall, plus named profiles handed out by permission
- Player control: /cdn toggle switches numbers off for one player and persists
- Bounded memory: capped displays, reference-counted viewer slots, distance culling, a bounded debug listener

## Commands

- /cdn help, /cdn version, /cdn backend
- /cdn stats - live counters, viewer slots, tick cost
- /cdn toggle [on|off] [player]
- /cdn style [player] <profile|default>
- /cdn test [type] [amount]
- /cdn clear [player|all]
- /cdn reload [config|messages|all]
- /cdn debug [on|off]
